🏁 The NATO RQ-4D drone has disappeared from Flightradar24. Its last recorded position was at 20:19 UTC off the coast of Burgas, heading west at 58,000 feet and squawking 7600. On Global Hawk drones, squawk 7600 can mean a loss of radio contact with air traffic… 🇺🇸 Now the US Navy P-8A Poseidon has also dropped off Flightradar24, about ten minutes after the NATO drone. Its last recorded position was at 20:29 UTC off the coast of Varna, at 5,300 feet, after more than four and a half hours circling over the western Black Sea. Either both aircraft switched off their transponders, or GPS jamming in the area wiped their positions from public trackers. Jamming would explain why two NATO surveillance aircraft went dark within ten minutes of each other in the same part of the Black Sea, on the same night Russian strategic bombers are reported in the air. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
